country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Era4 / Carbon3.ai Derbyshire modular AI data centre
notes: Full planning application submitted for a modular data centre at Erin Landfill, Duckmanton, Chesterfield. Trade coverage reports up to five HPE Mod Pods; Computer Weekly reported each pod is capable of 1.5MW and the site is expected to go live in H2 2026. Era4 site states Carbon3.ai rebranded as Era4 on 2026-03-04.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Xlinks Devon Data Campus
notes: Xlinks proposes an AI-optimised data centre and associated battery energy storage development near Alverdiscott, North Devon. DCD reported the proposed campus at 1.5GW; project consultation materials describe separate planning proposals for the data centre and BESS.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Doncaster / South Yorkshire AI Growth Zone datacentre proposal
developer: City of Doncaster Council; South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority; Automated Analytics-led industry submission
notes: Doncaster and South Yorkshire submitted expressions of interest to become a UK AI Growth Zone. Computer Weekly reported the council claim of 1.5GW AI processing capacity and plans for four AI-enabled datacentres in the region. This is an announced policy/investment proposal, not a named permitted site.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: BE Bournemouth data centre
notes: Operational Dorset/Poole-Bournemouth colocation facility at 300 Poole Road, Poole. DataCenterMap lists 3MW; BE project page describes the Bournemouth UK data centre as renewable-powered with AI hosting capacity, while the same page separately highlights 1MW project capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Fulcrum Bournemouth data centre
notes: Operational Tier 3-aligned carrier-neutral facility at Building 307, Bournemouth Airport Aviation Business Park. Fulcrum describes the site as a 24x7 managed Bournemouth data centre; DataCenterMap lists 6.5MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Datacenta Dorset Innovation Park data centre
notes: Operational hosting facility at Unit 20, The Quadrant, Dorset Innovation Park, Winfrith Newburgh. Datacenta states its data center is based at Dorset Innovation Park with high-speed connectivity back to Bournemouth; Inflect reports 120kW power capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: EBC Group Halesowen / UK data-centre platform
notes: EBC Group is headquartered at 221 Hagley Road, Hayley Green, Halesowen in the Dudley borough and says its UK data-centre estate includes Halesowen alongside Birmingham and Bristol, with private cloud/colocation services. Public MW not found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Yorkshire Energy Park Phase 1 energy centre and Tier 3 data centre
developer: Yorkshire Energy Park / Sewell Group; MS3 Networks; Vital Energi
notes: East Riding project on a 212-acre energy and technology business park near Hedon/Hull. Developer materials say the first data-centre build is designed for about 240 racks, expandable to 600 racks. Humber Freeport says detailed planning applications for the Phase 1 energy centre and data centre were submitted after outline permission; Barbour ABI identifies Phase 1 as a 13.5MW energy centre and Tier 3 data centre with January 2024 start and August 2026 finish.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: CloudConnX East Sussex colocation location
notes: CloudConnX offers server colocation at data centre locations including East Sussex, Croydon and London Docklands, and provides data-centre services from its Eastbourne-based business. Public project name, address and MW were not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Kao Data Harlow campus
notes: Kao's Harlow, Essex campus lists KLON-01 8.8MW operational, KLON-02 8.8MW operational, KLON-03 17.6MW under development, and KLON-04 36MW planned. Overall status marked construction because the campus has live capacity with active expansion under development.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Google Thurrock Data Centre / Arena Essex campus
notes: Project website identifies a planned new data centre campus on land south of the M25/A13 junction in Thurrock, under planning application 25/00573/OUT, brought forward by Google. Public coverage describes the Arena Essex site as about 52 hectares / 128 acres. Public MW not found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: East Havering Datacentre and Ecology Park
developer: Digital Reef / Reef Origin with London Borough of Havering
notes: Large campus proposed on the Havering/Thurrock boundary east of the M25. Havering materials describe up to 400,000 sq m of data-centre space; LDO documents say the order grants planning permission for up to 400,000 sq m of development. DCD reported a 600MW campus concept. Included under Essex because public materials describe the scheme as straddling Havering and Thurrock; exact split of datacentre buildings by boundary not confirmed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Aspire Heworth Hall Gateshead data centre
notes: Aspire says it operates six UK enterprise-class data centres including Gateshead; its Heworth Hall Gateshead facility is described as Tier 3 classified and ISO 27001 accredited. Gateshead Council also references data-centre tours of local infrastructure. Public MW not found.
